title: Phase C R2 residual — pinned operator_goal never bypasses bound-provenance chain validation
description: Audit R2 residual on fd3534e: missionOperatorGoal returned a pinned operator_goal BEFORE validating bound provenance, letting bound missions bypass binding-consistency checks. FIX: bound_open_id now takes precedence — the canonical chain work_open_binding(mission_id-consistent) → work_item.goal is validated on EVERY resolution; the pinned field is the immutable snapshot of that goal (identical by construction — any divergence → FAIL_CLOSED_BOUND_GOAL_PROVENANCE); legacy rows without the pin recover the snapshot from the chain; direct missions keep pin/goal fallback. Immutable snapshot + digest/replay semantics preserved. +5 regressions: pinned × {missing binding, mismatched binding, missing work_item, pin divergence} all fail closed with DETERMINISTIC code; pinned + intact chain resolves normally. 43/43 focused green.
